description: The official Mass Mobilization baseline, current Coding Procedure, exact present-day universe and terms of use remain unverified; the assigned country code 571 is provisional. The inherited educational codebook is an aid, not proof of current baseline compatibility.
required_followup: Coordinator should reconcile this unit against the authorized official baseline and current procedure before any consolidation or eligibility decision.

description: The January Gazette p.3 and 17 February follow-up document a state-directed 35% living-allowance demand and apparent petition submission at the start of 2022, but give no petition-submission attendee count. The January wording (“not rowdy when they submitted the petition”) suggests a possible in-person group; whether it was a public gathering and whether ≥50 people attended remain unverified. Eighteen school SRCs are organizational representation, not turnout.
required_followup: Seek a contemporary report or the petition/meeting record that identifies submission date, venue, format and number present; keep the larger demonstration described as looming on 17 February separate unless its own onset is documented.

description: Transport operators’ work stoppage is documented on 22 November 2021 at Gaborone Bus Rank and the BOPA report says operators were urged back to work after a ministry solution on 23 November. A 15 December Gazette snippet announced mobilization for a possible second strike before the end of January, but no January occurrence/onset evidence was found. Do not transfer the November action into January from that later announcement or February follow-up.
required_followup: If more evidence becomes available, locate a contemporaneous January report or operator notice establishing a fresh action’s occurrence/onset, attendance and government target. Exact December issue URL returned 403; no other route was attempted.

description: Mupane coverage conflicts on whether a work stoppage was initiated. The 31 January report says this once but quotes the union secretary saying it was preparing strike rules and went back to mediation to avert the looming strike; the December excerpt says no strike was permitted during a cooling-off period ending in January. The 111 figure is employees/union membership, not protest attendance.
required_followup: No resolution is needed for January event eligibility unless an actual public assembly or state-policy demand is independently documented. Do not convert strike planning or workforce size into protest turnout.

description: Two Botswana Gazette issue URLs hosted on images.assettype.com returned explicit HTTP 403 after fresh exact-URL access checks: the 12 January 2022 issue (S017) and 15 December 2021 issue (S012). The 17 December Mmegi Mupane page (S003) exposed an excerpt then an explicit sign-in/unlimited-access paywall. Each restriction is scoped to that exact source; no alternate URL or bypass was attempted. The 19 January Gazette issue at www.thegazette.news (S001) and the 31 January Sunday Standard page (S002) were readable.
required_followup: Use only separately captured public URLs under a fresh exact-URL access check and full ledger review. Preserve blocked URLs and excerpt scope; do not generalize one URL’s 403/paywall to its publisher.

description: Open-web discovery covered four January week windows, general protest/demonstration/strike terms, major Gaborone/Francistown/Maun/Palapye leads, labor, students, prices/transport, land, rights, electoral process and the controlled-investigations bill; it also queried local outlets and official/rights sources. Results do not represent LexisNexis or systematic newspaper archives, and empty results are not evidence that no protest occurred.
required_followup: Coordinator review should identify further regional outlet/archive checks if warranted and preserve the open-web versus hemeroteca coverage limitation.

description: Setswana equivalents (including boipelaetso and ditshupetso) were queried, but the results were sparse or unrelated and there was no systematic Setswana-language archive review. The first pass is predominantly English-language open web.
required_followup: Where language capacity and sources permit, repeat local-language searches and record exact query captures before concluding whether additional local reports exist.
